x: We had a small but keen contingent with Captain Brian Kolbe scoring fourth in the 'half'(2m.6s.) and second in the 220 in 25.7. Eric Penny was fourth in the mile, whilst new members Mike Smithers and Roy Bagley both finished fifth in the first and second string 440 event with times of 58.5 and 59.5 respectively.
Brian Kolbe led all the way in the 880 yds. only to be passed in the home straight; his time was 2m.4s. Match result:- Shaftesbury 31, Ealing 12, Maidenhead 10, Belgrave 7

Our junior Captain, Brian Kolbe performed creditably in both the 220 and 440 and is improving each time out. Eric Penny ran a very well judged race to win the mile in 4m.45·7s., an encouraging early season time.

In the junior match Brian Kolbe (2m.4·5s.) was our only winner although Eric Penny was narrowly beaten in the mile. The junior section must be hungrily awaiting the arrival of some of our promising youths.
Brian Kolbe was third in the 880 with 2:7.0 and Eric Penny 4th in the mile with 4:46.4. The Juniors followed the example of the seniors by winning the relay.
